newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Nike cut by Alex. Brown.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nike cut by Alex. Brown.

text.p: Alex. Brown said it downgraded Nike Inc to market performer from buy.
-- Analyst Marcia Aaron was not immediately available to provide additional details.

-- Earlier on Thursday, Nike said it expects earnings for the fourth quarter ending May 31 to be between $0.51 a share and $0.56 a share, below analysts' consensus estimate of $0.69 a share. Nike said the earnings will include a one-time, pre-tax charge equal to $0.04 a share.
-- Nike lost eight to 55-5/8 in morning trading.
